grammar_practice_close_aria: Collapse the sentence & grammar practice chat
grammar_practice_intro: Write a sentence in {language}; if it's wrong I'll correct it and explain its grammar word by word. Or ask any grammar question you have — about this sentence or something completely different — right here, and I'll answer like a language teacher.
grammar_practice_move_title: Hold and drag to move this box
grammar_practice_open_aria: Open the sentence & grammar practice chat
settings_android_only: This feature only works in the Android app
settings_bg_error_format: Only JPG, PNG, and GIF images are supported.
settings_bg_error_save_failed: Couldn't save the image — try a smaller file.
settings_bg_formats_hint: JPG, PNG, and GIF are supported.
settings_bubble_plugin_missing: Bubble plugin not found in this app build
settings_grant_permission: Please grant the permission, then tap again
settings_live_audio_description: Translates into your target languages. Earlier sentences stay in a scrollable history.
settings_magnifier_description: The 🔍 magnifier docks at the screen edge like the live bubble. Drag it over any text (in any app) and release: the text is highlighted and its translations into your selected languages appear in a popup. Tap a word, or drag across several words, to save it for the next story, grammar or the Leitner box. To close the magnifier, drag it onto the ✕ at the bottom of the screen. The text language is the “Audio language” below. Screen reading works for Latin-script languages (English, French, Spanish, Italian, German…) and Hindi.
settings_magnifier_missing: This app build does not include the magnifier yet — please update the app
settings_mascot_reset_done: The mascot is back in its original place
settings_notification_access_needed: Turn on “Notification access” for this app, then come back and tap again. (If it is greyed out: App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings.)
settings_song_hint_accurate: Most accurate but slower — recent phones
settings_song_intro: A special speech pack for songs and for speech over background music. While it is on, ALL live translation uses it.
settings_song_now_on: Now ON — for talk or videos switch it off.
settings_song_off_list: talking, videos, reels, podcasts, classes — with it off the text appears word by word and faster.
settings_song_on_list: listening to songs • voices over music • you don't know the audio language (Auto)
settings_song_on_note: On: text arrives in chunks every few seconds and gets refined; it uses more battery. Switch it off after the song.
settings_song_tip: Tip: set the audio language above — it makes song recognition much more accurate. The accurate mode needs a recent phone.
settings_speech_ask: The offline speech pack for {label} (~{mb} MB) is not downloaded yet. Download it now? (one-time)
settings_speech_busy: Another speech pack is being downloaded right now. When it finishes, tap again.
settings_speech_started: The download has started. Tap again when it finishes.
settings_sync_description: Download once. After that, syncing a story's audio runs on your phone, offline. Then use the Sync button on the “My audio” bar of a story.
settings_sync_download_failed: Download failed — check your connection / VPN and try again.
settings_tabs_customize_hint: Use the arrows to reorder tabs.
settings_tts_intro: Until a language's voice is downloaded, the phone's voice is used (Persian/Arabic use the online service). Once downloaded, that language is read with the offline pack — no internet needed. Each voice is roughly 60–110 MB; the first download also fetches a small shared data pack.
settings_voice_engine_hint: Choose whether texts are read with the app's own voice or the voice installed on your phone.
settings_voice_install_packs_hint: To let your phone read more languages aloud, install that language's voice package from your phone's settings.
settings_voice_install_steps_android: If the button above doesn't open settings, go to: Phone Settings ⟶ Language & input ⟶ Text-to-speech output ⟶ Google engine ⟶ Install voice data
settings_voice_install_steps_desktop: Windows: Settings ⟶ Time & language ⟶ Speech ⟶ Manage voices. Mac: System Settings ⟶ Accessibility ⟶ Spoken Content ⟶ Manage Voices.
settings_voice_install_steps_ios: Go to: iPhone Settings ⟶ Accessibility ⟶ Spoken Content ⟶ Voices, and download the language you need.
settings_voice_persian_note: Persian is read automatically over the internet for free; nothing to install.
settings_whisper_note: For this language the offline pack is less accurate and slower than for languages with a dedicated pack. Text may appear a few seconds late and some words may be recognized incorrectly. We are working on improving it.
settings_youtube_description: Play a video in the YouTube app: its subtitles appear in the bubble, in sync with playback, with your selected translations. Language of the video = “Audio language” above. You can also toggle it with the ▶ button inside the bubble panel.
settings_youtube_missing: This app build does not include YouTube subtitles yet — please update the app
